items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: I’ll hear this Cuban guy do this and I’m like, I’m taking that.

ctx.x: Yeah. You hear a lot of guys who sound exactly like this. They’re good players but they’re copying. They don’t come into their own voice. But I love, I mean I still take lessons, I go to hear everyone, and I’ll hear this Cuban guy do this and I’m like, I’m taking that. Or hear this guy, I’m talking— ooh check that out, what’s this, how’s that? And the drumming community is like that. We can sit down, check this riff out, this pattern, look at this. Bass players talk about the instrument, you know, a hundred…
family. But the drummers share. But yeah I think good players copy, great players steal. But I wasn’t a Buddy Rich protégé.
